user.title: Portainer Maintenance
user.description: One-time setup. Enter the URL where the Portainer actions webapp is reachable (e.g. https://actions.o.pumapants.cc). This integration registers it as a sidebar panel, installs its automation/script blueprints, computes the notification click-through URL automatically, and exposes the update/trouble/stale tracking sensors.
